title: Update verify-document API — accept hash from QR, recompute from DB, compare
completion_summary: Updated verify-document API with hash verification: imports document-hash functions, accepts optional hash field, computes server hash for quotation/invoice types, returns hashMatch/hashProvided/hashComputed, backward compatible when hash absent, error handling via try/catch
acceptance_criteria: Request body now accepts optional 'hash' field: { uuid, number, type, hash? }
If hash is provided: fetch document from DB, call getQuotationCanonicalData / getInvoiceCanonicalData, compute hash server-side with computeHashServer
Compare provided hash with computed hash — return result with hashMatch: true/false and hashProvided/hashComputed fields
If hash matches AND number matches: return { success: true, hashMatch: true, document, companyInfo }
If hash does NOT match but number matches: return { success: true, hashMatch: false, document, companyInfo, hashWarning: '...message...' }
If hash is not provided: fallback to existing behavior (number-only verification) — fully backward compatible
Import getQuotationCanonicalData, getInvoiceCanonicalData, computeHashServer from document-hash.ts
Use dynamic import for document-hash or ensure it works in Node.js runtime (only use computeHashServer, not Web Crypto)
Hash verification is additive — existing number verification flow untouched when hash absent
Error handling: hash computation failure returns { hashMatch: false, hashError: '...' } without breaking verification
